summary: Teck Resources filed a Form 6-K furnishing press release 26-21-TR dated October 6, 2026, announcing that third quarter 2026 earnings results will be released before market open on October 29, 2026, with a listen-only webcast and dial-in investor analyst Q&A at 8:00 a.m. PT / 11:00 a.m. ET. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed. This is an ordinary earnings-scheduling notice for a Canadian foreign private issuer, mapped to a routine US Form 8-K investor-relations item. Nothing to arbitrage; watch October 29 operational and copper growth guidance.
